editionContext.baseText: Ganjoor online transcription of Ferdowsi's Shahnameh, Sohrab sections.
editionContext.criticalPrintEdition: Not independently established for this online transcription.
editionContext.scope: Eight selected narrative beats; intervening episodes are condensed, and the complete Shahnameh is not represented.
editionContext.evidencePolicy: Use actual verse for narrative assertions. Site-generated AI summaries and museum story synopses are not the selected base text.
editionContext.translationPolicy: Original English paraphrases prepared for this sample; not a quoted modern translation.
editionContext.editorialReview: A specialist edition and verse-locator check remains pending before release.

spoilerPolicy.rule: Show a record only when spoilerLevel is at or below the selected boundary and all other publication/access checks pass. Recompute graph layout, labels, counts, media and recommendations after filtering.
spoilerPolicy.readerKnowledgeNote: The reader learns Sohrab's parentage in section 5; the characters' later recognition is a separate event.
spoilerPolicy.distributionNote: This complete editorial JSON includes ending spoilers. Do not expose it wholesale as a spoiler-filtered public response. Source pages can contain later material beyond the cited passage.

entities.label: Rostam and Sohrab

entities.label: Rostam
entities.summary: A warrior whose search for his missing horse opens this selected narrative.

entities.label: Zal
entities.summary: A figure in Rostam's family, also known as Dastan.

entities.label: Tahmineh
entities.summary: A woman who meets Rostam in Samangan and makes a consequential choice.

entities.label: Sohrab
entities.summary: A young warrior who seeks his father and sets out with ambitious plans.

entities.label: Rakhsh

entities.label: King of Samangan
entities.summary: The unnamed ruler who welcomes Rostam while he searches for Rakhsh.

entities.label: Afrasiab
entities.summary: A ruler who sees an opportunity in Sohrab's expedition.

entities.label: Kay Kavus
entities.summary: The king who summons Rostam during the confrontation with Sohrab's forces.

entities.label: Samangan
entities.summary: The narrative setting where Rostam is welcomed after losing Rakhsh. No modern coordinate match is asserted.

entities.label: Zabulistan
entities.summary: A region associated with Rostam and his family in the selected narrative; no modern boundary is asserted.

entities.label: Turan
entities.summary: The narrative region whose border is named in Rostam's opening hunting journey.

entities.label: Rostam's keepsake token

reviewNotes: No historical or BCE dates are assigned to literary events, lifespans, or places.
Manuscript artwork dates describe creation of depictions, not the represented narrative events.
No modern coordinates or territorial equivalences are asserted.
No living private individuals, user accounts, invitations, or mutual social relationships occur in this sample.
All catalog-image bytes remain external references; rights metadata does not establish runtime availability or completed visual/accessibility review.
Rostam explicitly refers to having a son in section 9. Do not replace non-recognition in combat with the claim that he did not know a son existed.
A source-backed statement is not a declaration of historical fact; all narrative claims belong to the selected literary world.

An original approximately 20-second explanatory diagram video, poster, English captions and transcript were prepared for the version 0.5 content sample. It uses spoiler level 2 and does not alter the narrative calendar mapping. Container metadata and representative frames were inspected; no product playback/access behavior was tested.

Version 0.6 replaces ambiguous participant lists with role-qualified event associations, adds relationship scope and explicit local-demo eligibility, and includes an original local family illustration. Entity, relation, event and source IDs are retained.
